_provenance.author: Gerald Dagher — every entry is a verbatim excerpt of a user message from a recorded session transcript; none were written or paraphrased by an AI, so this corpus may measure AI-authored matchers without sharing an author with them
_provenance.truncation: entries beginning or ending mid-sentence are search-window truncations of longer messages, marked with leading/trailing ellipsis fields; the words present are exact, typos and dictation fillers included
_provenance.use: measuring intake against how outcomes actually arrive: rough, nonlinear, dictated, multi-concern
